# Reproducibility caveats (GPT round-3 audit, 2026-04-22):
#  - RNG surface currently seeded in run_streamed_rate_train.py:
#      * torch.manual_seed(args.seed)
#      * np.random.seed(args.seed)
#      * DataLoader generator: torch.Generator().manual_seed(args.seed)
#  - NOT seeded (may introduce non-determinism):
#      * python `random` module (not used heavily but imported by deps)
#      * CUDA:  torch.cuda.manual_seed / manual_seed_all
#      * cuDNN: torch.backends.cudnn.deterministic / benchmark
#  - Default --seed is 42. Rerunning on CPU with the same seed
#    reproduces test_accuracy within +/- 0.1 pp in spot checks, but
#    exact bit-for-bit match is not guaranteed until the above extras
#    are pinned.
#  - Best-effort reproducibility only; strict paper-grade determinism
#    requires adding the missing seeds (see Phase C artifact cleanup).
